govt_response.title: Minister's written reply, Lok Sabha, 23 July 2025
govt_response.summary: Says the project is complex and technology intensive and exact completion timelines can be ascertained only after civil, track, electrical, signalling, telecom and trainset works finish; all civil contracts awarded and full land (1,389.5 ha) acquired; land delays in Maharashtra affected the project until 2021.

analysis:
At the foundation-stone event on 14 September 2017, news reports said the Rs 1.10 lakh crore, 508 km project was expected to be completed by 2022; separate reports said the government aimed for a first run on 15 August 2022 while the official deadline stayed at December 2023.

The project was not operating in 2022. In a written Lok Sabha reply on 23 July 2025 the Railways Minister gave December 2027 for the Gujarat section (Vapi-Sabarmati) and December 2029 for the whole corridor, adding that exact timelines can be fixed only after all associated works are complete.

As of 30 June 2025, Rs 78,839 crore had been spent against an estimated cost of about Rs 1.08 lakh crore, with JICA financing 81%. A November 2025 report said the Bilimora-Surat section would be ready by August 2026; this was not confirmed in 2026 coverage found.
notes: The 2022 target is reported by news (PTI) as a govt target at the 2017 ceremony; I found no verbatim Modi sentence giving the date, so quote_is_verbatim=false and the 15 Aug 2022 deadline comes from 2017 press reports (Wire, pressreader HT) not fetched in full.
